content:
**1) LAYOUT**
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized). Standard Windows 11 chrome (Title bar + Taskbar).
*   **Sidebar (Left):** [0, 60] to [275, 920]. Fixed width ~275px. Contains navigation sections.
*   **Main Content Area (Center):** [280, 60] to [750, 920]. Contains the primary selection workflow.
*   **Menu Panel (Right):** [755, 60] to [1000, 640]. A slide-out or persistent settings menu.
*   **Footer/Action Bar (Bottom of Main):** [280, 840] to [750, 920]. Contains help text and the primary CTA.
*   **Alignment:**
    *   Sidebar items are left-aligned with consistent padding (~16-24px).
    *   Main area uses a grid for "Internal drives" (2 columns visible) and a list/flex layout for "Specify a location".
    *   The "Search for Lost Data" button is right-aligned in the footer.

**2) TEXT (VERBATIM)**

*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** `Data Recovery`
*   **Sidebar - Item 1:** `Hardware Disk` (with green checkmark badge)
*   **Sidebar - Item 2:** `SD Card`
*   **Sidebar - Item 3:** `More Recovery Tools`
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** `Advanced Features`
*   **Sidebar - Item 4:** `File Repair`
*   **Sidebar - Item 5:** `Lost Partition Rescue`
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** `File Backup`
*   **Sidebar - Item 6:** `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Area - Heading:** `Select a location to search for lost data` (followed by refresh icon)
*   **Main Area - Subheading:** `Internal drives (2)`
*   **Card 1 (Selected):** `Windows(C:)`, `31.16 GB/149.45 GB`
*   **Card 2:** `Temporary`, `146.12 GB/15...` (truncated)
*   **Main Area - Subheading 2:** `Specify a location`
*   **Location Item 1:** `Recycle Bin`
*   **Location Item 2:** `Desktop`
*   **Location Item 3:** `Select Folder`
*   **Footer Text:** `Unable to find your hard drive?` (followed by info icon)
*   **CTA Button:** `Search for Lost Data`
*   **Menu Items:**
    *   `Language`
    *   `Help`
    *   `Activate`
    *   `Check for Updates`
    *   `Share EaseUS to`
    *   `Refer Friends`
    *   `EaseUS File Repair`
    *   `EaseUS Todo Backup Free`
    *   `ChatPDF`
    *   `Settings`
    *   `User Survey` (with red dot)
    *   `About`

**3) COLOR (ESTIMATED HEX)**
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   App Background (Main/Sidebar): `#F5F8FC` (Very light blue-grey)
    *   Sidebar Selected Item: `#E1EBFA` (Light blue)
    *   Menu Panel Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Card Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Accents & States:**
    *   Primary Blue (CTA, Selection Border, Icons): `#287DFA` or `#2B7EF6`
    *   Success Green (Checkmark): `#2ECC71`
    *   Alert Red (Notification Dot): `#FF4D4F`
    *   Progress Bar Fill (Blue): `#287DFA`
    *   Progress Bar Track (Grey): `#E0E0E0`
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headings, Selected Item): `#1F1F1F` or `#333333`
    *   Secondary Text (Subheadings, Stats): `#666666` or `#777777`
    *   Tertiary Text (Section Headers in Sidebar): `#888888` or `#999999`
*   **Borders:**
    *   Card Border (Selected): `#287DFA` (Solid, ~2px)
    *   Card Border (Normal): `#E0E0E0` or transparent with shadow
    *   Divider Lines (Menu): `#F0F0F0`

**4) TYPOGRAPHY (ESTIMATES)**
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI / System Font, 12px, Regular.
*   **Main Heading ("Select a location..."):** Segoe UI / Sans-Serif, ~22-24px, Semi-bold (600).
*   **Subheadings ("Internal drives", "Specify..."):** Segoe UI, ~14-15px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Card Titles ("Windows(C:)", "Recycle Bin"):** Segoe UI, ~15-16px, Medium (500).
*   **Card Stats ("31.16 GB..."):** Segoe UI, ~12-13px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Segoe UI, ~14-15px, Regular.
*   **Menu Items:** Segoe UI, ~14px, Regular.
*   **CTA Button:** Segoe UI, ~15px, Medium/Semi-bold, White.

**5) SPACING & SIZING**
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~275px.
*   **Menu Width:** ~240px.
*   **Card Dimensions:** Approx 280px width x 120px height.
*   **Card Padding:** ~16px internal padding. Icon is roughly 48x48px or 64x64px.
*   **Gutters:**
    *   Between Sidebar and Main: ~10-20px.
    *   Between Main Cards: ~20-30px.
    *   Between Menu Items: ~2px divider, ~12px vertical padding per item.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Cards: ~8px - 10px.
    *   CTA Button: ~6px - 8px.
    *   Menu Panel: Likely 0 or small radius on top-left if floating (looks like a drawer).
*   **Shadows:**
    *   Cards: Very subtle drop shadow (0px 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)).
    *   Menu Panel: Distinct shadow to separate from main bg (e.g., -4px 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)).

**6) CONTROLS & STATES**
*   **Sidebar List:**
    *   `Hardware Disk`: **Selected State** (Blue background, Blue text/icon, Green checkmark badge on right).
    *   `SD Card`, `More Recovery Tools`: **Normal State**.
*   **Device Tiles (Cards):**
    *   `Windows(C:)`: **Selected/Focused State** (Blue border, Blue checkmark circle icon in top-right corner).
    *   `Temporary`: **Normal State** (Grey border or subtle shadow, no checkmark).
*   **Location Items (`Recycle Bin`, etc.):** **Normal/Clickable State** (Icon + Text, no visible border container, hover likely adds background).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   `Search for Lost Data`: **Primary CTA Button** (Solid Blue background, White text, full height ~48px).
*   **Menu Items:** **List Items** with chevron right icons (`>`) indicating sub-menus or actions.
*   **Badges:**
    *   Green Circle Checkmark (Sidebar).
    *   Red Dot (User Survey).

**7) ICONOGRAPHY**
*   **Style:** Flat, "Fluent Design" style (outlined/pixel-perfect filled hybrid), using the **Segoe Fluent Icons** font or similar SVG set.
*   **Weights:**
    *   Sidebar/Menu icons: Outline or light fill, 1.5px - 2px stroke.
    *   Card Icons (Drive/Folder): Filled, illustrative, soft gradients/shading (3D-ish but flat).
*   **Specifics:**
    *   Hardware Disk: Grid of 4 squares (Windows logo style) + Disk shape.
    *   SD Card: Rectangle with notch.
    *   Recycle Bin: Standard bin shape, grey.
    *   Desktop: Monitor shape.
    *   Folder: Standard folder shape.
    *   Refresh Icon (next to heading): Circular arrow.
    *   Info Icon (footer): 'i' in circle.

**8) STATE**
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Selection Ready**. The user is at the first step of the wizard ("Select a location"). No data is loading (no spinners on cards), no error messages blocking the view (except the helpful footer link). The selection is pre-populated or user-selected on "Windows(C:)".
*   **Motion Cues:** None explicitly captured, but the "Refresh" icon implies dynamic updating capability. The layout is static.
